title: Zebra dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='94' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#3a4a6a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='68' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='66' width='8' height='22' rx='4' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='36' y='72' width='8' height='4' fill='#6a6a9a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='70' width='8' height='4' fill='#6a6a9a'/>
  <rect x='36' y='82' width='8' height='4' fill='#6a6a9a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='80' width='8' height='4' fill='#6a6a9a'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='36' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a5a7a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a5a7a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#f2f2f8'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M30 52 q6 6 0 14' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 48 q6 10 0 22' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 47 q6 12 0 24' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 49 q5 10 0 20' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front legs, dancing pose -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-25 34 70)'/>
  <rect x='62' y='62' width='8' height='16' rx='4' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(30 66 62)'/>
  <!-- hooves front -->
  <rect x='24' y='80' width='9' height='6' rx='2' fill='#5a5a7a' transform='rotate(-25 28 83)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='74' width='9' height='6' rx='2' fill='#5a5a7a' transform='rotate(30 72 77)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M68 50 L78 34 L86 38 L74 56 Z' fill='#f2f2f8'/>
  <path d='M72 46 l6 -8' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='34' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f2f2f8' transform='rotate(-15 84 34)'/>
  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d='M80 28 q3 6 0 12' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 27 q3 7 0 13' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='94' cy='36' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#c8c8dc'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <path d='M80 25 l-2 -10 l8 4 z' fill='#f2f2f8'/>
  <path d='M80 25 l-1 -7 l5 3 z' fill='#d88ab0'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M72 30 l-4 -8 l6 2 l-2 -7 l6 3 l-1 -7 l6 4' fill='#5a5a7a' stroke='#5a5a7a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='31' r='2.2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='88.7' cy='30.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M26 56 q-10 4 -8 16' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 72 q-2 4 2 6 q4 -2 2 -6 z' fill='#5a5a7a'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#ffcc33'>
    <path d='M14 30 l0 -12 l8 -3 l0 12' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='31' r='3.5'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='27' r='3.5'/>
    <path d='M88 12 l0 -10 l7 -2 l0 10' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='13' r='3'/>
    <circle cx='93' cy='10' r='3'/>
  </g>
</svg>
